sections.label: Effect
sections.text: The weatherwise can [teleport](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/teleport) up to 5 squares before or after using this ability.

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: Each target can spend a [Recovery](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/recoveries), and can choose one effect on them that can be ended by a [saving throw](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw). That effect instead ends at the end of their turn.
